body:
Same with these values 

toLocaleString
toString
valueOf 

The JavaScript object prototype functions ....

It is a fun bug lol. The bug is on `isSpecialChar` and `isModifier` called from `typeChars` in `packages/driver/src/cypress/keyboard.coffee`.

Please note the following behaviour of the Javascript dictionary behaviour:

> modifiers = {alt: false, ctrl: false}
{alt: false, ctrl: false}
> modifiers["alt"]
false
> modifiers["hello"]
undefined
> modifiers["toString"]
ƒ toString() { [native code] }

The last one is not ok.

![whid](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1740517/55677703-9c3e4a00-58ba-11e9-941e-34d0372ca328.gif)

Let me see what I can do there.

issue.title: #3423 Enable Cyrpess to type strings containing reserved words

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

issue.body:
close #3423 

I have made Cypress to be able to type some Javascript reserved words such as "hasOwnProperty" and "toString".  In addition, I've added some tests taken from the big naughty list of strings.
